title: Guardrail Gauntlet
blurb: Messages rush a gate and each bouncer decides: pass, review or block.
lesson: Jev screens fast and cheaply; the scoreboard shows what each bouncer caught and missed.
why: A guardrail reads every message before the chatbot does, so it has to be fast and cheap. Jev returns a typed decision with a probability, which is what a gate needs.
A miss here is a prompt injection let through or a good customer blocked. Compare the catches and misses, not only the speed.
